notes_body: Encoding page Fig 13.6 [#f-lick_matched_gauss_perspout] (docked-spout ITI; rows 1 and 3 of the render, first-lick rows 2 and 4 on the page). DOCKED-SPOUT ITI = lick onset while the spout is docked (Priya's primary ITI set, 10-29; frozen all-ITI decoder, nothing refit); PS95 has too few docked licks at some spouts, so those cells are 3 / 3. Docked ITI: read more contralesional acutely after close ipsi +0.26 (3 / 3), close mid +0.23 (3 / 3), far ipsi +0.34 and far mid +0.33 (4 / 4), not after close contra (+0.10) or far contra (+0.21, 3 / 4); after close mid, far ipsi and far mid in every epoch (close mid +0.23 / +0.23 / +0.34; far ipsi +0.34 / +0.34 / +0.39; far mid +0.33 / +0.21 / +0.24); chronically also after close ipsi +0.24 and close contra +0.23 (4 / 4). Docked ITI first lick of each bout: CI excludes 0 at every spout and epoch (acute +0.26 to +0.44). Cued: far contra +0.26 acute (4 / 4), then -0.06 n.s. / -0.28 [-0.39, -0.14] (4 / 4, ipsilesional chronically); close ipsi +0.31 acute (4 / 4), +0.14 chronic n.s. (3 / 4); close mid +0.20 and far ipsi +0.17 acute (4 / 4). SIGN: + = READ more contralesional than the lick landed (decoder like-for-like offset, a DIRECTION quantity; page sign-conventions box); landing / decoded lateral position + = contralesional; image left = ipsilesional. Decoder: frozen pre-stroke KEY-row lateral lick-position decoder per lick set (z-scored Allen areas with the ALM / tjM1 split, lags 0-0.2 s, August pre sessions, pre scored leave-one-session-out). Licks: LP video licks (cam4 detector) with 3-D tongue position from cam1 + cam4 pose. LIKE-FOR-LIKE offset = each lick's decoded lateral position minus a Gaussian-weighted mean (sigma 0.1 mm, chosen by held-out pre prediction) of the decoded positions of the animal's PRE licks of the same set that LANDED at the same lateral place (any spout, no bins); 0.1-3.2 % of licks without a reference (most in acute docked ITI). Session means; change vs pre, 95 % paired nested bootstrap (animals -> sessions), * = CI excludes 0, k/n animals. PROVISIONAL (n = 4).
